# netapp-ontap_iscsi_service (Resource)

Protocols iSCSI Service resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netapp-ontap_iscsi_service" "protocols_iscsi_service" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster2"
  svm_name        = "svm02"
  enabled         = true
  target = {
    alias = "cl2vs2"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `svm_name` (String) iSCSI SVM name

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) iSCSI should be enabled or disabled
- `target` (Attributes) iSCSI target properties (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) iSCSI Service UUID

<a id="nestedatt--target"></a>

### Nested Schema for `target`

Optional:

- `alias` (String) iSCSI target alias of the iSCSI service

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) iSCSI target name of the iSCSI service

## Import

This resource supports import, which allows you to import existing iSCSI service into the state of this resource.
Import require a unique ID composed of the SVM name and connection profile, separated by a comma.

id = `svm_name`,`cx_profile_name`

### Terraform Import

For example

```shell
 terraform import netapp-ontap_iscsi_service.example svm1,cluster4
```

!> The terraform import CLI command can only import resources into the state. Importing via the CLI does not generate configuration. If you want to generate the accompanying configuration for imported resources, use the import block instead.

### Terraform Import Block

This requires Terraform 1.5 or higher, and will auto create the configuration for you

First create the block

```terraform
import {
  to = netapp-ontap_iscsi_service.iscsi_import
  id = "svm1,cluster4"
}
```

Next run, this will auto create the configuration for you

```shell
terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf
```

This will generate a file called generated.tf, which will contain the configuration for the imported resource

```terraform
# __generated__ by Terraform
# Please review these resources and move them into your main configuration files.
# __generated__ by Terraform from "svm1,cluster4"
resource "netapp-ontap_iscsi_service" "iscsi_import" {
  cx_profile_name = "cluster4"
  svm_name        = "svm1"
  enabled         = true
  ...
}
```
